# cisco.reference-bare
shape 3acf22f15cd3 algo 1
[aaa]
aaa new-model
tacacs server TACACS > address ipv4 192.0.2.10
tacacs server TACACS > key <secret>
tacacs server TACACS > single-connection
tacacs server TACACS > timeout 5
aaa group server tacacs+ LAB-TACACS > server name TACACS
aaa authentication login default local group LAB-TACACS
aaa authentication login CONSOLE local
aaa authorization exec default local group LAB-TACACS if-authenticated
aaa accounting exec default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 1 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 5 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 7 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 15 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa session-id common
line con 0 > login authentication CONSOLE
line vty 0 4 > login authentication default
[roles]
privilege exec level 1 show running-config
privilege exec level 7 undebug all
[snmp]
ip access-list standard TACCTL-SNMP > permit host 192.0.2.10
ip access-list standard TACCTL-SNMP > permit 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255
ip access-list standard TACCTL-SNMP > deny any
snmp-server community <secret:1> RO TACCTL-SNMP
snmp-server location <v>
snmp-server contact <v>
[mgmt-acl]
ip access-list standard VTY-ACL > permit 192.0.2.10 0.0.0.0
ip access-list standard VTY-ACL > permit 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255
ip access-list standard VTY-ACL > permit 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.255
ip access-list standard VTY-ACL > deny any log

# cisco.synthetic-system-new
shape 24e95070aaf9 algo 1
[aaa]
aaa authentication login CONSOLE local
aaa accounting commands 15 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
line con 0 > login authentication CONSOLE
[snmp]
snmp-server trap-source Loopback0
[system]
banner login <v>
ip domain name lab.example.net
ip domain list lab.example.net
clock timezone CET 1
ip name-server 192.0.2.53
ip name-server 192.0.2.54
ntp authentication-key 5 <secret>
ntp trusted-key 5
ntp server 192.0.2.123 version 4 key 5 prefer
ntp server ntp2.example.net
ntp authenticate

# cisco.synthetic-vrf-new
shape 6fa515325330 algo 1
[aaa]
aaa authentication login CONSOLE local
aaa accounting commands 15 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
line con 0 > login authentication CONSOLE
[snmp]
snmp-server host 192.0.2.61 vrf MGMT version 2c <secret:2>
snmp-server host 192.0.2.62 informs version 2c <secret:2>
snmp-server host 192.0.2.63 version 2c <secret:2> udp-port 1162 config
[system]
ip domain name lab.example.net
ip domain name vrf MGMT mgmt.example.net
ip domain list lab.example.net
ip domain list vrf MGMT mgmt.example.net
ip name-server 192.0.2.53
ip name-server vrf MGMT 192.0.2.53
ip name-server vrf MGMT 192.0.2.54
ntp server 192.0.2.123 prefer
ntp server vrf MGMT 192.0.2.123 version 3 prefer
ntp server vrf OOB ntp2.example.net
